plants.sentence: A hidden layer without a non-linearity adds real expressive power, because an affine function of an affine function is no longer affine.
If you do not specify an initialisation method, deep learning frameworks use a default random initialisation, which guarantees the best possible result on every problem.
An epoch means the model has processed every training example once; with 1,000 examples and a mini-batch size of 100, one epoch takes 100 iterations.
ReLU often works a little better than sigmoid or tanh because it is less susceptible to the vanishing gradient problem, and it was designed specifically for image classifiers.
When training loss keeps falling while validation loss rises, the falling training loss is what causes the validation loss to rise.
